entries.title: The dev dashboard now reads in plain English
entries.summary_plain: Every card on the board has been rewritten for someone who does not read code - what it does and why it matters, with the technical detail tucked behind a click. Progress now leads the page: how far along we are, what shipped this week, what is stuck and who we are waiting on. Everything else starts folded away, and the page remembers what you left open. Two things it will never hide: anything blocked, and anything failing. The Alpha warning is smaller but still red and still there. The board also now says how long ago it was last updated, because a dashboard that is quietly out of date is worse than no dashboard.

entries.title: You can see how your posts and accounts are performing
entries.summary_plain: There is a new Analytics screen. It shows each connected account's followers over time, and how every published post did. Where a platform has not reported a post's numbers yet, it says so instead of showing zeros, because a confident zero reads as failure when the truth is that nobody has counted yet.

entries.title: You can reply to messages, comments and reviews without leaving Sahoda
entries.summary_plain: Replies can now be sent straight from the inbox. Where a platform closes the window for a free reply some hours after the customer wrote, the reply box explains that before you write rather than refusing after you press send.

entries.title: Posts show where they have got to without you refreshing the page
entries.summary_plain: A post that is going out now updates itself on screen as it moves from waiting to sending to sent, on both the posts list and the planner. Until now the page had to be reloaded to find out, so a post could have gone out minutes earlier and still look stuck.
